TELEFLIX
TELEFLIX is streaming based service which is designed to cater different genre of bangla contents (song, movie, drama, short film) to end user. Now the people of Bangladesh will find the solid taste of bangali entertainment in their smart phones. From classic to modern, from jazz to normal all desi entertainment will be at finger tip.
It is a subscription based streaming service that offers HD quality bangla video content. Video content includes movie, drama, short film, HD movie trailer, video song, fashion shows, health shows, teaser etc.
User Interface
User subscribes to the service via. USSD, SMS & APP/WAP/WEB
Once subscribed, the subscriber browsing the app will get direct access to the content
